LanguageData.Raven_Weapon_Kageame.label: [Raven] Kageame
LanguageData.Raven_Weapon_Kageame.description: A uniquely designed special weapon resembling an ancient gunlance. It can fire lethal purple-black armor-piercing rounds from a distance, while its sharp and heavy blade can easily tear through enemy armor in close combat. It is a fierce weapon that dominates at both long and short ranges.
